غببت (form I)

# غَبَبْتَ (ḡababta) /ɣa.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of غَبَّ (ḡabba)
# غَبَبْتِ (ḡababti) /ɣa.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of غَبَّ (ḡabba)
# غُبِبْتُ (ḡubibtu) /ɣu.bib.tu/: first-person singular past passive of غَبَّ (ḡabba)
# غُبِبْتَ (ḡubibta) /ɣu
